plugins.name: tokenwise
plugins.description: Measurement-driven model router for Claude Code. Classifies every subtask by type and routes it automatically — mechanical work to Haiku, execution to Sonnet, review to Opus, large planning to Fable — with no per-task prompts, logs token usage per task class to a local NDJSON, and proves savings via on-demand A/B tests. Auto-detects whether routing/env-var primitives work on your Claude Code build before configuring. Exposes /tokenwise:install, /tokenwise:report, /tokenwise:summary, /tokenwise:ab, /tokenwise:undo.
